message.content:
I dropped out of the Pennsylvania Avenue auction, leaving gemini-4-argon (p2) with the high bid at $185.

- **Why I stopped:** gemini-4-argon only has $223, so I could have outbid them at $224. But green houses cost $200 each, and I can't afford to build there soon even if I eventually got North Carolina as well.
- **Gemini's position:** if they pay $185 they're left with about $38. That makes it hard to add more houses on Park Place and Boardwalk, which are my biggest danger.
- **My plan:** I keep my $857 for houses on my light blues (Oriental, Vermont, Connecticut). At $50 each, nine houses cost $450, which still leaves a cushion against dark blue rents.

The downside is that gemini-4-argon now blocks me from completing the greens.
message.reasoning:
Since P2 can only bid up to $223, bidding $224 would secure Penn and lock up two of three greens, but I need to weigh that against my own building plans on the light blues—I've got $857 but no houses yet, so spending $224 leaves $633, and after the 9 houses at $450 I'd still have some cash left to work with.

Actually, letting P2 take it for $185 or so drains them down near $38, keeping them too poor to build on Boardwalk/Park Place, which is the real danger since dark blue rents with houses get into the $1100 range. That outweighs the value of blocking the greens myself, so I'll drop out and let P2 overspend here.
